questions.text:
How does a cultural process operate to shape a geographic environment you have studied?

In your response:
- name a cultural process and the geographic environment(s) shaped by it
- construct a supporting annotated map or diagram in the space provided
- integrate comprehensive supporting case study evidence
- you may integrate other annotated maps and diagrams to support your answer.
questions.expectedAnswer: Names a cultural process (e.g. urbanisation, globalisation, tourism, migration) and analyses how it shapes the geographic environment with case study evidence.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (A3-A4): Analyses aspects of the cultural process and how they shape the geographic environment(s) with some supporting case study evidence. Includes some accurate description of the cultural process, partially analyses how the process shapes the environment, describes or refers to how the environment is impacted. Merit (M5-M6): Analyses in detail aspects of the cultural process and how they shape the geographic environment(s) with detailed supporting case study evidence. Includes detailed evidence with visual components, describes how the cultural process shapes the environment. Excellence (E7-E8): Provides an insightful analysis of the cultural process and how it shapes geographic environment(s) with comprehensive supporting case study evidence. Integrates comprehensive evidence throughout, explores how the environment is impacted with insight, draws conclusions about links between elements of the cultural process.
